description: This file provides utility classes and functions for handling API error responses in a Flask application. It defines a structured ApiError exception class that can be converted into a JSON response and a helper function to abort with JSON errors.

classes.name: ApiError
classes.description: An immutable exception class representing structured API errors with HTTP status codes and optional error details.

methods.name: to_response(self)
methods.description: Converts the ApiError instance into a Flask JSON response payload, including the message and optional errors.

methods.name: abort_json(status_code: int, message: str, errors: dict[str, Any] | None = None)
methods.description: Raises an ApiError with the specified status code, message, and optional error details to be handled globally.

ctags.name: abort_json
ctags.pattern: /^def abort_json(status_code: int, message: str, errors: dict[str, Any] | None = None):$/
ctags.signature: (status_code: int, message: str, errors: dict[str, Any] | None = None)
